title: Riverbend Medical Hardship Documentation Schedule — Other Medical Costs of the Window
content:
## Schedule of other medical costs

Under the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care), the qualifying medical debt documented with the other medical costs of the window (the 12 whole months before the documentation day) is the qualifying medical debt recorded on the case, rounded half-up to the cent and never below zero; the documented figure is rounded half-up to the cent.

| Recorded on the case (hypothetical) | Documented figure |
|---|---|
| 4,250.00 | 4,250.00 |
| 0.00 | 0.00 |

The figure read is the one the case carries on the documentation day.
